entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: lowerCall routes only the eight known value-reading date functions plus timestampFunctionName to lowerDateFn, the sole caller of projectDateFnOverInner. The timestamp spelling is excluded by this guard and takes the timestamp branch; every other dispatched name is implemented by dateFnExpr. A parseable wire query therefore cannot supply an unknown name here; the error is reachable only through a forged internal parser.Call in tests.

guard: if c.Func.Name != timestampFunctionName && dateFnExpr(c.Func.Name, nil, nil) == nil
